notes.title: CRAZY MAZE is finally available with 20% discount!
notes.notes:
Today we are launching our first game on steam. We hope you will like it. 
We appreciate your feedback and reviews. Tell us what you want to see in the future. Stay tuned for updates, we have a lot of ideas!
Have fun,
Adrian Waltrowski and Łukasz Tabaczkiewicz.
